_comment: Service configuration for Stargate's ASP.NET host, UDP ingestion, and Python automation helpers.

Transceiver._comment: Defines where the UDP listener expects telemetry frames from the BLonQ transceiver or future gateway.

PythonAutomation._comment: Controls the helper processes Stargate launches (mock generator and dashboard) when automation is enabled.

Processes._comment: Simulated telemetry source that emits UDP payloads at 250 Hz.
Processes.Name: BLonQ Transceiver Mock

Processes._comment: FastAPI dashboard that provides the browser-based telemetry front-end.
Processes.Name: Telemetry Web Dashboard

Kestrel._comment: Expose the gRPC endpoint over HTTP/2 so clients can subscribe to streaming telemetry.
